datasets.title: Global random noise, IGEO7 level 4
datasets.description: All 24 012 cells of refinement level 4 (12 pentagons), stored as a single cell id range. Synthetic values between 1 and 20.

datasets.title: Global random noise, IGEO7 level 5
datasets.description: All 168 072 cells of refinement level 5, stored as a single cell id range. Synthetic values between 1 and 20. Takes about half a minute to draw.

datasets.title: Porijõgi catchment elevation, IGEO7 level 10
datasets.description: 3 101 cells in south-east Estonia in 136 cell id ranges, with elevation and slope. Small and quick to load.

datasets.title: Estonia elevation statistics, IGEO7 level 12
datasets.description: 11.85 million cells in 39 697 cell id ranges. Drawn at level 10 as the mean of the level 12 cells; about 32 MB per variable and about a minute to draw.
